newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel halts as air raid sirens mark Memorial Day.
newsitem.headline: Israel halts as air raid sirens mark Memorial Day.

text.p: Air raid Sirens brought the Jewish state to a standstill for one minute on Saturday to mark national Memorial Day honouring soldiers killed in nearly half a century of independence.

Israeli President Ezer Weizman lit a memorial torch in Jerusalem's Old City at the Western Wall, the remnant of the ancient Jewish Temple destroyed in Roman times that is now Judaism's holiest shrine.

The Defence Ministry said 18,538 soldiers had been killed since Israel's independence in 1948, most in Arab-Israeli wars. Israel television read the names of fallen soldiers in chronological order in a broadcast slated to last hours.

The Israeli army said it had imposed a general closure on the West Bank and Gaza entry of Palestinians to Israel to guard against possible attacks during Memorial Day and Israel's 49th Independence Day which begins Sunday evening.
